WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-10-28' AND f.sale_date<= DATE '2025-01-26' q3base, f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-27' AND f.sale_date<= DATE '2026-01-25' q3cur, f.channel_code, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) amt, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) GROUP BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code,
  CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'base' WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 'cur' END per,
  f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.receipt_id
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key))
SELECT store_id, channel_code,
 sum(net_amount) FILTER (per='base') base_amt, sum(net_amount) FILTER (per='cur') cur_amt,
 count(DISTINCT sale_date) FILTER (per='base') base_days, count(DISTINCT sale_date) FILTER (per='cur') cur_days,
 sum(net_amount) FILTER (per='base' AND staff_purchase_flag) base_staff, sum(net_amount) FILTER (per='cur' AND staff_purchase_flag) cur_staff
FROM s WHERE per IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH fs AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) gross_all, sum(f.net_amount) FILTER (NOT staff_purchase_flag) excl_staff, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
fr AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, r.return_date d, sum(r.refund_net) rn FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'base' ELSE 'cur' END per,
 count(*) n_rows, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before, sum(fs.gross_all) fact_all, sum(fs.excl_staff) fact_exstaff,
 sum(r.returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(fr.rn) fact_ret, sum(r.net_sales) rpt_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.net_sales_before_returns-fs.gross_all)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch_all,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.net_sales_before_returns-fs.excl_staff)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch_exstaff
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r LEFT JOIN fs ON fs.store_id=r.store_id AND fs.sale_date=r.business_date LEFT JOIN fr ON fr.store_id=r.store_id AND fr.d=r.business_date
WHERE (r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1

WITH x AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_week - 26 AS wk, CASE WHEN f.sale_date<DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'b' ELSE 'c' END per, f.net_amount, f.sale_date
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')),
w AS (SELECT store_id, wk, sum(net_amount) FILTER (per='b') b, sum(net_amount) FILTER (per='c') c, count(DISTINCT sale_date) FILTER (per='b') bd, count(DISTINCT sale_date) FILTER (per='c') cd FROM x GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT store_id, wk, b, c, round(c/b,3) ratio, bd, cd FROM w WHERE c IS NULL OR b IS NULL OR c/b<0.75 OR c/b>1.3 OR bd<>cd ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'sales_orphan_store' k, count(*) v FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_orphan_store', count(*) FROM fact_return_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'ts_date_mismatch_q3', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date<>CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) AND (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')
UNION ALL SELECT 'savonlinna_last_sale_date_'||CAST(max(f.sale_date) AS VARCHAR), count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=129 AND f.sale_date>DATE '2026-01-18'
UNION ALL SELECT 'savonlinna_sales_after_close', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=129 AND f.sale_date>DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_in_q3_not_matching_sale_store', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.store_key<>f.store_key AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_negative_or_zero', count(*) FROM fact_return_line WHERE refund_net<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line', count(*)-count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_keys_in_q3_per_store_gt1', count(*) FROM (SELECT s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_key)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_dates_in_closed_store_days', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE NOT d.is_trading_day AND f.channel_code='ST'

calls.statement:
WITH cur_store AS (SELECT store_id, region, open_date FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900),
sales AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'current' END per, f.net_amount AS amt
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key)
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'current' END, -r.refund_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key)
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')),
st AS (SELECT c.store_id, c.region, c.open_date, sum(amt) FILTER (per='prior') p, sum(amt) FILTER (per='current') c FROM sales JOIN cur_store c USING (store_id) GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT region,
 round((sum(c) FILTER (open_date IS NULL)/sum(p) FILTER (open_date IS NULL)-1)*100,2) main_lfl,
 round((sum(c) FILTER (open_date IS NULL AND store_id<>129)/sum(p) FILTER (open_date IS NULL AND store_id<>129)-1)*100,2) ex129,
 round((sum(c) FILTER (store_id<>137)/sum(p) FILTER (store_id<>137)-1)*100,2) inc136,
 round((sum(c)/sum(p)-1)*100,2) all_stores,
 count(*) FILTER (open_date IS NULL) n_stores, sum(p) FILTER (open_date IS NULL) base, sum(c) FILTER (open_date IS NULL) cur
FROM st GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date<DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'current' END per, count(*) n, max(net_amount) mx, max(quantity) mq, quantile_cont(net_amount,0.999) p999,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_bad,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount>=1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) big
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IS DISTINCT FROM 99 AND (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25') GROUP BY 1

WITH cur_store AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND open_date IS NULL),
sales AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'current' END AS per, f.net_amount AS amt
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key)
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'current' END, -r.refund_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key)
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')
SELECT c.region, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter,
 round((sum(amt) FILTER (per = 'current') / sum(amt) FILTER (per = 'prior') - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM sales JOIN cur_store c USING (store_id) GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region
